newsitem.title: USA: BPA lowers off-peak electricity offers by 50 cents.
newsitem.headline: BPA lowers off-peak electricity offers by 50 cents.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) reduced the price of its pre-scheduled power offers for Wednesday delivery by 50 cents per megawatt (MWh), the agency said Tuesday.

Wednesday prices for non-firm power for hours ending at 0600 and 2300 PDT were lowered to $9.00 from $9.50 on Monday for Tuesday deliveries, while prices for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 were lowered to $8.50 from $9.00.
Firm power during off-peak hours on Wednesday was also lower at $8.50 from $9.00 per MWh.
